content.description: This document solidifies the scope for security alpha testing and auditing. It defines the systems and data considered within the initial security review.

in_scope_systems.description: The core application runtime environment, including all deployed Node.js services.
The source code repository, specifically focusing on code changes and access controls.
The infrastructure hosting the LifeOS platform.

in_scope_data_types: User authentication credentials (hashed passwords, API keys)

out_of_scope_systems.system_name: Third-party integrations not directly managed by LifeOS
out_of_scope_systems.description: External services like Stripe, Google APIs, etc., are assumed to have their own security posture and are out of scope for this internal review, except for the integration points themselves.
Security of individual developer machines is not part of this alpha scope.

audit_objectives: Identify critical vulnerabilities (e.g., injection, XSS, broken access control)
Verify secure configuration of infrastructure and application components
Assess adherence to secure coding practices
Review data protection and privacy controls
content.notes: This scope is intended for the initial alpha security review. Future phases will expand the scope to include additional systems and data types as the platform matures.
